lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice asking follow-up questions to catch times, places, and reasons in a practical conversation.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Confirming details before leaving home for an appointment or errand.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Asking for clarification about practical details.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik check the time, place, and reason for a short appointment before deciding when to leave.

main_focus.name: question formation with time, place, and reason words
main_focus.description: Use common question words with Swedish verb-second question order to ask for details.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use detail questions naturally 4-5 times across the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use everyday appointment words and several reusable clarification questions.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person mentions an appointment or errand.
dialogue_shape.middle: The conversation asks and answers about time, place, reason, and what to bring.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide when to leave and what detail still needs checking, if any.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat question patterns with different question words

focus: the practical purpose of the appointment or errand
the key details that must be confirmed
what plan is made before leaving

sentence_focus: one sentence with behöver ta med
one sentence confirming a time or address
